title: Installation.
officialText:
Such valves shall be installed in the shell of the water heater tank. Temperature relief valves shall be so
located in the tank as to be actuated by the water in the top 6 inches (152 mm) of the tank served. For installations with separate
storage tanks, the valves shall be installed on the tank and there shall not be any type of valve installed between the water heater
and the storage tank. There shall not be a check valve or shutoff valve between a relief valve and the heater or tank served.
